title: Neural Data Bench: task–resource evidence map
scope: Active candidate catalog plus measured custom slices; excluded proposals/unresolved-access resources preserved in versioned evidence archive. Neither catalog count nor category coverage proves completeness.

readiness.B: Existing benchmark or published evaluation protocol; public execution still requires setup
readiness.B*: Published benchmark; full reusable release not independently confirmed
readiness.B/D: Existing protocol for some listed tasks; custom wrapper for others
readiness.D: Reusable data/tool with proposed benchmark wrapper
readiness.R: Research construction; not an easy ready-made benchmark

effort: Relative setup estimates for a small slice, not measured runtimes: Low = existing labels and modest wrapper; Medium = substantial preprocessing/adapter/GPU setup; High = large 3D/raw data or new protocol.
metrics_and_splits: Recommended design. Preserve official definitions whenever claiming official benchmark comparability. Secondary metrics and additional OOD splits are proposed.
verification: Every entry has a bounded admission assessment; review depth varies and inherited URLs were not all refetched. Only measured slices have acquired/scored data. Exhaustive literature and currentbest are not established.

known_scope_boundaries: Clinical diagnosis, prognosis and normative lifespan modeling beyond selected EEG/MRI examples require a dedicated cohort/confounding review.
PET/SPECT, neurochemistry and autonomic modalities remain underrepresented; no clean low-effort ground-truth suite admitted.
Stimulation safety, invasive interventions and live closed-loop control are outside current execution.
Animal vocalization is now explicitly represented; hardware/sample-rate differences still need wrappers.
Spatial molecular inference is represented, but developmental, evolutionary and comparative diversity remains incomplete.
Analytical theory, formal proofs and open-ended scientific discovery need separate validity criteria.
